description: Public Wi-Fi Locations is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Public Wi-Fi Locations This dataset shows locations of public wi-fi provided at LCC buildings and properties across the city. It provides a map of these locations and breakdown in relation to the type of building i.e. library, museum etc. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under the publisher Leicester City Council. Its tags are internet, wi-fi, wifi. It offers 15 resource(s) in HTTPS://WWW.IANA.ORG/ASSIGNMENTS/MEDIA-TYPES/APPLICATION/GPX+XML, HTTPS://WWW.IANA.ORG/ASSIGNMENTS/MEDIA-TYPES/APPLICATION/JSON, HTTPS://WWW.IANA.ORG/ASSIGNMENTS/MEDIA-TYPES/APPLICATION/LD+JSON, HTTPS://WWW.IANA.ORG/ASSIGNMENTS/MEDIA-TYPES/APPLICATION/OCTET-STREAM, HTTPS://WWW.IANA.ORG/ASSIGNMENTS/MEDIA-TYPES/APPLICATION/PARQUET. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
